description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from CRISPR-Cas9 knockout and mass spectrometry-based high-throughput screening of protein interactions and signaling changes in human cancer cell lines.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or screening observation.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking multiple records generated within the same screening experiment or batch.

perturbed_gene_symbol.descr: HGNC-approved symbol of the gene knocked out by CRISPR-Cas9 (for example, TP53, KRAS).

perturbed_gene_id.descr: Stable database identifier for the perturbed gene, such as Ensembl Gene ID or NCBI Gene ID.

perturbed_protein_name.descr: Protein name corresponding to the knocked-out gene product.

perturbed_protein_id.descr: Stable protein identifier for the perturbed target, such as UniProt accession.

interacting_gene_symbol.descr: HGNC-approved symbol of the protein or gene whose interaction or downstream response was measured.

interacting_gene_id.descr: Stable database identifier for the interacting or downstream gene, such as Ensembl Gene ID or NCBI Gene ID.

interacting_protein_name.descr: Protein name of the detected interactor or downstream signaling molecule.

interacting_protein_id.descr: Stable protein identifier for the detected interactor, such as UniProt accession.

relationship_type.descr: Observed relationship between perturbed protein and interacting protein; examples include activation, inhibition, direct binding loss, indirect signaling change, or association.

causal_direction.descr: Direction of the inferred causal effect; examples include upstream_to_downstream, downstream_to_upstream, bidirectional, or undetermined.

effect_size.descr: Quantitative magnitude of the observed change, such as log2 fold change in interaction abundance or signaling readout.

effect_unit.descr: Unit for the effect size, for example log2FC, fold change, or normalized intensity change.

effect_sign.descr: Direction of change relative to control; for example increased, decreased, or no_change.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance of the observed change.

adjusted_p_value.descr: Multiple-testing adjusted p-value or false discovery rate.

confidence_score.descr: Overall confidence in the interaction or causal inference, on a defined scale such as 0 to 1.

replicate_count.descr: Number of experimental replicates used for this record.

cell_line_name.descr: Human cancer cell line used in the experiment, for example A549, HeLa, MCF-7.

cell_line_id.descr: Stable identifier for the cell line, such as Cellosaurus accession.

cancer_type.descr: Cancer type or lineage associated with the cell line, for example lung adenocarcinoma, breast carcinoma.

species.descr: Biological species of the experimental system; expected value is Homo sapiens.

culture_format.descr: Cell culture format or growth condition, for example adherent, suspension, co-culture, or 3D spheroid.

passage_number.descr: Approximate cell passage number at the time of the experiment, if available.

crisp_cas9_delivery_method.descr: Method used to deliver CRISPR-Cas9 components, for example lentiviral transduction, electroporation, or ribonucleoprotein delivery.

guide_rna_sequence.descr: sgRNA sequence used to target the perturbed gene, reported 5' to 3'.

guide_rna_count.descr: Number of guide RNAs used to target the gene in this record or pooled assay.

knockout_validation_method.descr: Method used to confirm knockout, for example western blot, qPCR, amplicon sequencing, or functional assay.

knockout_validated.descr: Indicates whether gene knockout was experimentally validated.

mass_spectrometry_platform.descr: Mass spectrometer or platform used, for example Orbitrap, Q Exactive, or timsTOF.

mass_spectrometry_mode.descr: Acquisition mode or workflow, for example DDA, DIA, PRM, or label-free quantification.

protein_enrichment_method.descr: Method used to enrich interacting proteins prior to MS, for example co-immunoprecipitation, affinity purification, pull-down, or proximity labeling.

labeling_strategy.descr: Quantitative labeling strategy, for example TMT, SILAC, label-free, or no-label.

sample_preparation_method.descr: Key sample preparation workflow used before mass spectrometry.

control_condition_description.descr: Description of the matched control condition used for comparison, for example non-targeting sgRNA, wild-type cells, or mock treatment.

treatment_or_stimulus.descr: Any additional treatment, drug, ligand, or stimulus applied during the experiment, if present.

incubation_time_hours.descr: Duration in hours between perturbation or treatment and sample collection.

temperature_celsius.descr: Experimental or incubation temperature in degrees Celsius.

media_condition.descr: Culture medium and relevant supplements, for example DMEM + 10% FBS + penicillin/streptomycin.

oxygen_condition.descr: Oxygen level during culture or treatment, for example normoxia, 1% O2 hypoxia.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date on which the sample was collected, if tracked.

analysis_pipeline.descr: Software or analytical pipeline used for MS data processing and interaction inference.

analysis_version.descr: Version of the analysis software or pipeline.

database_used_for_identification.descr: Reference protein database used for peptide/protein identification, for example UniProt, RefSeq, or Ensembl.

protein_identification_confidence_thresh.descr: Threshold used to accept protein identifications, such as peptide/protein FDR cutoff.

literature_reference_doi.descr: DOI of the supporting publication describing the interaction, pathway, or method.

literature_reference_pmid.descr: PubMed ID of the supporting publication.

literature_reference_year.descr: Publication year of the supporting reference.

literature_reference_author.descr: First author or short author string for the supporting reference.

supporting_evidence_type.descr: Type of supporting evidence, for example prior literature, this study only, orthogonal validation, or database evidence.

orthogonal_validation_present.descr: Indicates whether an additional validation method beyond mass spectrometry supports the interaction or causal relationship.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for any additional experimental or interpretive details not captured by the structured fields.
